title: Open-then-closed module support extension and canonical scalar comparison
statement: Let $\Lambda,\Lambda\prime$ be commutative condensed rings, $\rho:\Lambda\to\Lambda\prime$ a ring-object morphism, and $S\xrightarrow{j}C\xrightarrow{i}Z$ morphisms of schemes with $j$ an open immersion. Use the internal module categories over the pulled-back rings [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Define the support-extension functor $F_\Lambda=j_!^\Lambda\mathbin{;}i_*^\Lambda$ from $\Lambda_S$-modules to $\Lambda_Z$-modules, using the open extension by zero [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek] and module direct image [def-sfb-module-lower-star]. For a $\Lambda_S$-module $N$, define the canonical scalar/support arrow $\operatorname{Ext}_{\rho_Z}(F_\Lambda N)\to F_{\Lambda\prime}(\operatorname{Ext}_{\rho_S}N)$, with coefficient maps $\rho_T$ [def-sfb-coefficient-map] and scalar extension [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], as the composite of the closed/direct-image scalar mate $\operatorname{Ext}_{\rho_Z}i_*^\Lambda j_!^\Lambda N\to i_*^{\Lambda\prime}\operatorname{Ext}_{\rho_C}j_!^\Lambda N$ [def-sfb-push-hom] and $i_*^{\Lambda\prime}$ applied to the open scalar isomorphism [def-sfb-open-immersion-shriek-iso]. The construction is defined for arbitrary $i$; when $i$ is closed it is the open-then-closed support comparison. No flatness hypothesis and no claim of invertibility are part of this definition.

lean.statement:
def finiteStageSupportScalarMap
    {Λ Λ' : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] [MonObj Λ'] [IsCommMonObj Λ']
    (ρ : Λ ⟶ Λ') [IsMonHom ρ] {S Z T : Scheme.{u}}
    (j : S ⟶ Z) (hj : IsOpenImmersion j) (i : Z ⟶ T)
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ S)) :
    (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap ρ T)).obj
        ((finiteStageSupportExtension Λ j hj i).obj N) ⟶
      (finiteStageSupportExtension Λ' j hj i).obj
        ((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap ρ S)).obj N)
